title: Duplicate identical diagrams share one SVG element id
description: README Limitations: if the exact same diagram (same code+theme) appears twice, both copies reuse the memoized SVG markup from render.ts cache, so two <svg id="dsh-mermaid-N"> elements exist in the document. Internal url(#...) references (arrow markers, styles scoped by #id) resolve to the first copy; disposing/hiding the first copy breaks markers of the second. Expected: every injected diagram SVG has a document-unique id and its internal references point inside itself.
acceptance_criteria: Red commit with a real-client test showing duplicate ids; fix commit; test green.
close_reason: Fixed: red commit 775aace (deterministic real-client regression test/web/duplicate-ids.test.ts showed two identical fences sharing svg id dsh-mermaid-1); fix commit b9a4b1c assigns a fresh element id per application of a cached render; full suite 22/22 green

title: dsh-TUI inertness property test
description: Plugin is not in the fleet dsh-tui profile. acceptance_criteria: Inertness property passes with seed log; SPEC records TUI surface not applicable.
close_reason: Done: test/tui/mermaid.tui.inertness.test.ts on a real dsh-TUI (flake dsh-tui 0.14.0 via DSH_TUI_DIR): with the plugin the ui-mermaid row is in dump-config, no load warnings, two full turns render byte-identically to a TUI without the plugin, process alive. Option-3a rationale in SPEC.md and the test header
